revision_note: round-28 law-replay build (2026-10-18): two repairs landed. (1) RL-4, the packet_keys gap: examples/culture-d4/components/03-orthography.yml now declares `packet_keys: [orthography, records, literacy_institutions]` and examples/culture-d4/components/09-costumes.yml gains `enforcement`, so OR-01..OR-03, LI-01..LI-03 and EN-01..EN-02 reach the packet as records instead of riding assembly.skipped_keys. (2) RL-1, the missing replay leg: tools/gates/register-law-gate.py (new) replays the register_law rows' speaker/force/consequence/register/axis/kind/design_row clauses against the packet's own blocks and emits the D4L-LAW-* finding class, so a tampered row (force: no-such-force, an unresolvable speaker id, a consequence naming no machinery) now adds a named finding where round 27 measured an identical set. The hold set is UNCHANGED at 12 holds / 0 notes / 0 fails: a law row is not a form, so the six garment-form obligations still route to their twelve record/slot rows and the register stratum owes no form slot. Command: python3 tools/assemble-culture-d4.py; python3 tools/d2-typed-labels.py --packet examples/culture-d4/packet.d4.yml --emit examples/culture-d4/typed-labels.d4.yml; evidence: reports/round-28/law/impl-1.md. The round-27 pins are recorded under supersedes_pins; no historical generation is overwritten in place.
